assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one transparent-background full-body mascot sprite for a Japanese elementary-school English prefix learning app. A small friendly mint-green rounded seed-shaped creature, two short feet, two tiny arms, dark forest-green dot eyes, a quiet curious smile. Side-facing three-quarter view looking right, feet at bottom, pointing gently toward the right. Warm hand-painted picture-book gouache texture, clean confident soft outlines, restrained muted mint, cream and pink. One single character only, centered with complete silhouette and a small amount of transparent margin. No ground, no shadows beyond the character, no other objects, no words, letters, symbols, logos or watermark. This sprite will travel along drawn paths, cross a benchmark, go back and repeat, so its form must remain extremely simple and legible at 60 pixels tall.

Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. One production illustration asset for a Japanese elementary-school English prefix picture-book app. PORTRAIT canvas, exactly TWO EQUAL horizontal panels stacked vertically, separated at the exact halfway point by a thin straight warm-cream line. Each panel is one complete centered landscape vignette. Warm hand-painted gouache picture-book style, gentle forest-green outlines, mint, warm cream, muted rose and golden accents; plain warm cream background in both panels. Same scale, characters, objects and camera in both panels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or watermark. This is one paired before-and-after asset: both panels must stand alone when shown separately. TOP PANEL: a small child with short dark hair, mint shirt and golden overalls, shown from waist up, looking content and happy with a clear gentle smile, relaxed eyebrows. BOTTOM PANEL: exactly the same child and framing, looking unhappy or disappointed with a downturned mouth and slightly worried eyebrows, arms relaxed, no crying, no frightening imagery. The only meaningful change is the emotional state. Do not turn the child into a different person or add a cause for the emotion.
